Food was good but not worth the price tag; customer service was bad overall
Sep 2025 • Solo
I had been to Yuzu before and the last time it was a great experience. I booked dinner today for their special 2nd anniversary called "Hoi" (in collaboration with Mua Sake) and expected a great treat, but it turned out to be a disaster for various reasons.

- Food (which is the most important in my book) - Good but the quantity was fairly disappointing. The price tag is higher than usual, but both the quantity and quality were lower than usual. The combination of Vietnamese and Japanese cuisine was creative, but I am not sure if it justifies the price tag.
- Services - This is where things went wrong, on so many dimensions (and if you're Vietnamese/ work in Vietnam, do read on). 
 - Delay - I was rushing to arrive on time, only to be told that the dinner would be delayed by 10-15 mins (which turned out of be a good 20 mins). It would have been ok if the dinner weren't at 8PM and stretched to start at only 8:20-8:30... The restaurant told us to be on time, or else they would reserve the right to refuse entry, but they (a Japanese restaurant) refused to let guests in until 20 mins past the booking time. I was also asked if I wanted any drink while waiting, to which I said yes, and none was brought to be during the 20 minutes...
 - Gift - There was some drinking game during the dinner, which I won, and the gift was supposed to be some lunch voucher. None was given to me, but I didn't bother asking cause I was sure I would not want to return.
 - Tax invoice (for the Vietnamese/ those who work in Vietnam) - When I made the booking and was asked to pay deposit, I was also given the option of getting the red invoice for the deposit amount of VND 5M (~50% of the bill). I asked the staff if I should tick the box, to which I said no need and told me that I could just red the tax invoice after paying for the whole amount after dinner. Guess what, after dinner they refused to issue the invoice because they said they could only issue the invoice up to 5M... I was like WTF... I didn't bother arguing any further, but if they didn't want to issue to the invoice to dodge tax or whatever, they might as well just have said so since the beginning.

All in all, a waste of time, a waste of money. The quality clearly has dropped vs. 1-2 years ago. The only saving grace was the lady chef at the counter, who seemed genuinely nice and wanted the customers to have a good experience. She's the 1 star that I decided to leave for this rating.

Intimate, creative omakase in Saigon
May 2025 • Friends
Tried the Journey menu at Yuzu and had a memorable experience. The counter setup lets you watch the chefs in action—great energy and attention to detail.

Standouts included toro, uni, and a sushi course wrapped in gold leaf. The truffle dish added a fun, unexpected twist. While some dishes were more subtle than others, the progression felt well thought-out and enjoyable.

Plan for a longer meal—it’s over 20 courses—so don’t rush. Ideal for a special occasion or if you’re curious about premium ingredients in an omakase format.
